name: Directed Framing Trap
description: Frame the pairwise constraints as highly directional (e.g., "asymmetric protocol", "one-way check") to bait models into building a directed graph. Because the underlying mathematical constraint (12 and 21 are divisible by 3) is symmetric, the proper constraint propagation requires an undirected graph. A directed BFS will fail to fully traverse weakly-connected components, leading to unpropagated constraints and incorrect lexicographical assignments.
